text.p: British retail group Kingfisher Plc announced a series of management changes including appointment of Jim Hodkinson, chief executive of B&Q as the chairman of its do-it-yourself sector.

The company also appointed Martin Toogood, stores director of B&Q supercentre as managing director of B&Q UK and Bill Whiting, Warehouse stores director as managing director of B&Q International. Both would report to Hodkinson.
Kingfisher also appointed Joe Riordon as B&Q's commercial director, Barry Stevenson as operations director and Stephen Robertson as marketing director.
The group said Tony Percival would retire as the group's finance director in May 1998 and would be succeeded by Roger Holmes, currently finance systems and supply chain director of B&Q.
